items.difficulty_reason: The category of differential graded modules is a Grothendieck abelian category: after lemma-dgm-abelian only a generator is missing, and the author exhibits G = direct sum over k and U of j_{U!}C_U[k] where C_U is the cone on the identity of A_U, then shows that a module with no maps from G is zero by computing the Hom sets as pairs (x, y) with x = d(y) degree by degree. Retained author proof at lines 2814-2840.
